summary: Backend-only testing for Alee Club Talent App. Executed 33 pytest cases across 10 feature areas (health, auth, users, events, applications, payments, certificates, notifications, AI scoring, admin). 33/33 PASSED. Razorpay is correctly running in MOCKED mode, Emergent LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5) works end-to-end, admin seeded, 4 sample events seeded, role enforcement verified, duplicate application prevention verified, PDF certificate generation verified (valid %PDF header).

minor.issue: Emails are lowercased on register (good). Should document this or make case-insensitive input explicit in OpenAPI description so frontend/tests align.
Returns full id_document stripped but the single-GET /api/applications/{id} returns base64 photos/videos/id_document which can be large — consider pagination/streaming for future.
Returns 200 even if event doesn't exist (idempotent but no explicit 404). Minor.
update_event first runs update_one then find_one; if event_id doesn't exist the update silently no-ops and returns 404 — order is fine but update leaks no-op silently.

action_items: No backend fixes required — all 33 tests pass.

Expo web logs show deprecation warnings: several package versions mismatch Expo's expected versions (expo-image-picker, expo-linear-gradient, expo-print, expo-sharing, expo-file-system, @react-native-async-storage/async-storage). Also 'shadow*' style props deprecated — switch to 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking for backend but should be cleaned up during frontend polish.
Consider documenting email lowercasing behavior in API docs.
When Razorpay keys are provisioned, flip from mock mode and re-run payment tests with real sandbox credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~850 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, events.py, applications.py, payments.py, ai.py, admin.py) as features grow.

CORS config uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Since current frontend uses Bearer tokens (not cookies), this is functionally OK today, but change to explicit origin list if cookies/credentials are ever needed.
Admin password is re-synced from .env on every startup (good for predictability), but logs nothing when rotated — add an INFO log on rotation for auditability.

Payment verify endpoint accepts mock:true from client — acceptable while RAZORPAY_KEY_* are empty (server also falls back to mock), but once keys are set, ignore client-supplied mock flag entirely to avoid bypass. Current code already does this (line 472 uses OR with server check), so safe.
AI scoring saves ai_score as-is into users doc including raw LLM text — fine, but consider TTL/limit to avoid growing doc.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created. Backend auto-seeds admin@aleeclub.com and 4 sample events on startup (verified). Tests create TEST_ prefixed users/events/applications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://glamour-audition.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Admin: admin@aleeclub.com / Admin@123 (auto-seeded & password refreshed from .env on startup). Participants are registered fresh per pytest session with TEST_user_<hex>@aleeclub.com. Razorpay is MOCKED (no keys in .env) — /api/payments/create-order returns {mock:true, order_id:'order_mock_...'} and /api/payments/verify accepts mock:true. Emergent LLM key is set and Claude Sonnet 4.5 responds in ~3s. Duplicate applications are blocked. Certificates only issue for status in ['selected','shortlisted']. Full test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — re-runnable with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues detected. One initial test failure (test_me_with_token) was a test-side assertion issue (backend correctly lowercases emails). Fixed in test; backend behavior is correct and documented.
